```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)  
library(lme4)      
library(lmerTest)  
library(emmeans)

```

```{r settings, results = "hide", message=FALSE, warnings = FALSE}
alphaThreshold <- 0.05  

# no suffix for the original ERP analysis, "_peakcorrected" for the peak corrected version
suffix = "" # _peakcorrected" 
cols_angle <- c("40" = "#f0b070", "90" = "#3f7fc4")
```

```{r eq_test}
# minimum effect and equivalence test 
me_eq_test <- function(b, se, df, sesoi, alpha = .05) {
  ci90 <- b + c(-1, 1) * qt(1 - alpha,     df) * se
  ci95 <- b + c(-1, 1) * qt(1 - alpha / 2, df) * se
  p_nhst    <- 2 * pt(-abs(b / se), df)
  p_equiv   <- max(pt((b + sesoi) / se, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
                   pt((b - sesoi) / se, df, lower.tail = TRUE))
  p_min_neg <- pt((b + sesoi) / se, df, lower.tail = TRUE)    # b < -SESOI
  p_min_pos <- pt((b - sesoi) / se, df, lower.tail = FALSE)   # b > +SESOI
  data.frame(estimate = b, se = se, ci90_low = ci90[1], ci90_high = ci90[2],
             ci95_low = ci95[1], ci95_high = ci95[2], sesoi = sesoi,
             p_nhst = p_nhst, p_equivalence = p_equiv,
             p_min_effect_neg = p_min_neg, p_min_effect_pos = p_min_pos)
}
```

```{r load-data, message=FALSE}

# table exported from the MATLAB pipeline
T <- read_csv(
  paste0("P:/Sein_Jeung/Project_Fold_Rotation/Results/grand_table", suffix, ".csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject           = col_character(),
    Trial             = col_double(),
    FoldingDifficulty = col_double(),
    FoldingAngle      = col_double(),
    ParietalNegativity = col_double(),
    latency           = col_double()
  )
)

T <- T %>%
  mutate(
    Subject           = factor(Subject),
    FoldingDifficulty = factor(FoldingDifficulty, levels = c(4, 6)),
    FoldingAngle      = factor(FoldingAngle, levels = c(40, 90))
  )

T2 <- T %>%
  mutate(
    Subject           = factor(Subject),
    FoldingDifficulty = factor(FoldingDifficulty, levels = c(0, 4, 6)),
    FoldingAngle      = factor(FoldingAngle, levels = c(0, 40, 90))
  )

contrasts(T$FoldingDifficulty) <- contr.treatment(2)
contrasts(T$FoldingAngle)      <- contr.treatment(2)


# drop rows with missing values
T_erp <- T %>% filter(!is.na(ParietalNegativity))
T_rt  <- T %>% filter(!is.na(latency))
T2_erp <- T2 %>% filter(!is.na(ParietalNegativity))


```

```{r erp-model}
## ERP MODEL ##
erp_model <- lmer(
  ParietalNegativity ~ FoldingDifficulty * FoldingAngle + (1 | Subject),
  data = T_erp,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(erp_model)
cf <- summary(erp_model)$coefficients

# Main angle contrast, averaged over folding difficulty
emm_angle <- emmeans(erp_model, ~ FoldingAngle)
angle_contrast <- contrast(emm_angle, method = "revpairwise")
summary(angle_contrast, infer = TRUE)
ac <- as.data.frame(summary(angle_contrast))

erp_res <- me_eq_test(
  ac$estimate,
  ac$SE,
  ac$df,
  sesoi = 0.3
)

erp_res

```

```{r rt-model}
## RT MODEL ##
rt_model <- glmer(latency ~ FoldingDifficulty * FoldingAngle + (1|Subject), data = T_erp, family = Gamma(link = "log"))
summary(rt_model)
```


```{r erp-cell-means}
erp_emm <- emmeans(erp_model, ~ FoldingDifficulty * FoldingAngle)
dfERP <- as.data.frame(erp_emm) %>%
  rename(ERP_fix = emmean) %>%
  mutate(
    Rotation = factor(FoldingAngle, levels = c(40, 90)),
    Folding  = factor(FoldingDifficulty, levels = c(4, 6))
  )

erp_emm

# Main contrast: 4 vs. 6 folds, averaged over folding angle
emm_difficulty <- emmeans(erp_model, ~ FoldingDifficulty)
pairs(emm_difficulty, infer = TRUE, level = 0.90)
emm_difficulty

# Main contrast: 40° vs. 90°, averaged over folding difficulty
emm_angle <- emmeans(erp_model, ~ FoldingAngle)
pairs(emm_angle, infer = TRUE, level = 0.90)
emm_angle
dfERP
```

```{r minimum effect test for RT}
sesoi_rt <- 1   # smallest effect size of interest, in seconds

# Cell means on the response scale (seconds), from the same model
emm_resp  <- regrid(emmeans(rt_model, ~ FoldingAngle * FoldingDifficulty))
emm_angle <- emmeans(emm_resp, ~ FoldingAngle)          # averaged over difficulty

# Helper: contrast -> estimate, SE, 90% CI, plus minimum-effect/equivalence tests
rt_tests <- function(con, sesoi) {
  ci <- as.data.frame(confint(con, level = 0.90))       # 90% CI for TOST logic

  # regridded objects use asymp.LCL/UCL; others use lower.CL/upper.CL
  names(ci)[grepl("lower.CL|asymp.LCL", names(ci))] <- "lower.CL"
  names(ci)[grepl("upper.CL|asymp.UCL", names(ci))] <- "upper.CL"

  keep <- setdiff(names(ci), "df")                       # keeps any 'by' columns
  out  <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(ci)), function(i) {
    cbind(ci[i, keep, drop = FALSE],
          me_eq_test(ci$estimate[i], ci$SE[i], df = Inf, sesoi = sesoi))
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

# 1) Means in seconds
means_angle <- as.data.frame(emm_angle)                 # 40° and 90°, averaged
means_cells <- as.data.frame(emm_resp)                  # every angle x difficulty cell

# 2) Angle effect (90° - 40°) averaged over difficulty
rt_avg <- rt_tests(contrast(emm_angle, method = "revpairwise"), sesoi_rt)

# 3) Angle effect within each difficulty level
rt_by <- rt_tests(contrast(emm_resp, method = "revpairwise",
                           by = "FoldingDifficulty"), sesoi_rt)

print(means_angle, digits = 3)
print(means_cells, digits = 3)
print(rt_avg,      digits = 4)
print(rt_by,       digits = 4)
```


```{r Helmert contrast}

T2_erp$FoldingDifficulty <- factor(T2_erp$FoldingDifficulty, levels = c("0", "4", "6"))

# Helmert coding, scaled so each coefficient is a raw difference in µV
contrasts(T2_erp$FoldingDifficulty) <- cbind(
  fold_vs_base = c(-2/3, 1/3, 1/3),   # mean(4, 6) - baseline
  four_vs_six  = c(0, -1/2, 1/2)      # 6 - 4 (not interpreted here)
)

diff_model <- lmer(
  ParietalNegativity ~ FoldingDifficulty + (1 | Subject),
  data = T2_erp,
  REML = TRUE
)

anova(diff_model)                      # omnibus F(2, df)
summary(diff_model)                    # coefficient FoldingDifficultyfold_vs_base is the h4 test
confint(diff_model, parm = "FoldingDifficultyfold_vs_base",
        method = "Wald", level = 0.95)
emmeans::emmeans(diff_model, ~ FoldingDifficulty)   # descriptive means only

```
